no_derivatives_created: No derivative raster was produced. No tier was derived, no scene scaffold was emitted, no plate was normalized. There is therefore no derivative hash to report, which is the honest answer rather than an omission.

identity_evidence.method: The repository copies were hashed and measured from their own bytes. Their sha256 values equal the values the P95 recent-Drive sweep recorded for these exact Drive IDs, and their byte counts equal the file sizes the live Drive metadata reports for those IDs today.
identity_evidence.limit: The authorized Drive connector exposes file size and MIME for these IDs but not a server-side content hash, and streaming 6.5 MB of image bytes back through a text channel is not a sound integrity check. So Drive-side identity is established by exact byte-count agreement plus the sweep's recorded hash, not by an independently recomputed Drive-side digest. That is the exact strength of the claim.

reachable_in_normal_play: NO. Neither the park nor the press briefing room is reachable in normal play, and this run did not change that. Intake measures and registers a picture; it does not create travel, an event, a schedule, or a place. No EnvironmentSceneSpec, no scene-registry entry and no scene consumer references either asset.

consumer_seam.where: src/presentation/scene-consumers.ts declares every player-facing surface that could show a room; src/presentation/scene-registry.ts registers the scenes; src/environment/scenes/*.ts author the specs; art/manifest/asset_manifest.json is the release ledger that src/presentation/production-office.ts reads.
consumer_seam.what_would_be_required: A released manifest entry with a derived tier ladder, an authored EnvironmentSceneSpec with measured geometry, a registry entry, and a consumer whose canonical gate is satisfied by real world state. None of the four exists for either asset, and three of them depend on human decisions listed in the release review.
consumer_seam.not_authorized_here: Building any of that is outside AX-92B1. This slice was bounded to intake.
